about.label: Our Story
about.heading:
We don’t design for the season.
We design for the years in between.
about.s1_p1: Nina et Michelle was born from a simple idea: that the pieces you wear every day deserve the most care, not the least.
about.s1_p2: From the first sketch to the final stitch, every detail is considered. We take our time selecting fabrics, perfecting silhouettes, and creating garments that feel effortless to wear.
about.s1_p3: We don’t believe in overdesign. We believe in thoughtful construction, timeless proportions, and quality that speaks without words.
about.s2_p1: Every collection begins with a thoughtful choice of fabric. We select materials for their texture, weight, and the way they naturally move with the body.
about.s2_p2: True luxury is found in simplicity — in the softness of natural fibers, refined finishes, and pieces designed to become part of everyday life. Cared for gently, they only get better with time.
about.quote: “Every collection carries a little piece of Paris—and a little piece of us.”
about.news_text: New collections, journal entries and quiet inspiration — occasionally, and only when it matters.
about.news_note: You can unsubscribe at any time.
